name: Nemotron-4 15B

lifecycle.note: Described in a technical report only. As of 2026-10-01 no NVIDIA weight release (Hugging Face or NGC) or NVIDIA-hosted access for this model was found.

relations.note: Editorial link along the Nemotron generation numbers: the report introduces Nemotron-4 without naming Nemotron-3 8B as its predecessor.

summary.text: Nemotron-4 15B is a 15-billion-parameter multilingual language model from NVIDIA, described in a technical report posted on arXiv on 26 February 2024. It was trained on 8 trillion tokens of English, multilingual and source-code text; NVIDIA says it was built as a general-purpose model that fits on a single A100 or H100 GPU.

changes.text: 15 billion parameters, up from 8 billion for Nemotron-3 8B.
Pre-trained on 8 trillion tokens covering 43 programming languages, against 3.8 trillion tokens and 37 programming languages for the Nemotron-3 8B base model.
Uses grouped-query attention, rotary position embeddings and squared ReLU activations; NVIDIA's Nemotron-3 8B model cards describe a GPT-3 style network.

features.note: Pre-training data covers 53 natural languages besides English and 43 programming languages.

contextWindowTokens.note: Given as the sequence length in the report's hyper-parameter table.

parameters.note: The report splits this into 3.2 billion embedding and 12.5 billion non-embedding parameters.

notes: Announced through the arXiv technical report (v1 2024-02-26, v2 2024-02-27). No released date: NVIDIA did not publish weights or a hosted service for this model. The Nemotron-4 340B report says Nemotron-4-340B-Base uses the same data blend as, and is similar in architecture to, Nemotron-4-15B-Base. NVIDIA says Nemotron-4 4B Instruct was distilled from it (relation stored on that record).
